Create Client.description: Create a new individual client. Requires officeId; legalFormId 1 = PERSON, 2 = ENTITY. Set `active: true` with an `activationDate` to onboard immediately.

Create Loan Application.description: Submit a new loan application for an existing client. The product id determines the schedule terms.
Create Loan Application.code:
// Submit a new loan application.
request('/loans', {
  method: 'POST',
  data: {
    clientId: $.data.clientId,
    productId: $.configuration.loanProductId,
    principal: $.data.principal,
    loanTermFrequency: 12,
    loanTermFrequencyType: 2, // 2 = months
    numberOfRepayments: 12,
    repaymentEvery: 1,
    repaymentFrequencyType: 2,
    interestRatePerPeriod: 24,
    amortizationType: 1,
    interestType: 0,
    interestCalculationPeriodType: 1,
    transactionProcessingStrategyCode: 'mifos-standard-strategy',
    expectedDisbursementDate: $.data.disbursementDate,
    submittedOnDate: $.data.today,
    dateFormat: 'dd MMMM yyyy',
    locale: 'en',
  },
});

Record Loan Repayment.description: Record a repayment transaction against a loan account.

Open Savings Account.description: Open a savings account for an existing client.

Register Webhook Hook.description: Register a Fineract Hook (Web template) so the platform POSTs an event to your OpenFn webhook URL whenever the chosen entity+action fires.

API Request (Beta).description: Raw HTTP request with authentication and the tenant header applied.

Find Client by External ID.description: Look up a client by an external identifier (e.g. national ID) maintained by Fineract.

Get Loan with Repayment Schedule.description: Fetch a loan plus its full repayment schedule and transactions.

Poll Recently Updated Loans.description: Cursor-style polling: list loans submitted on or after the last seen date. Useful as a fallback when Hooks / Kafka aren't enabled.
